list: Official PS5 trophy list as published by PlayStation, cross-checked on Exophase, PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements. Launch-era guidance: 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. It is the last trophy most players will earn, after the story, the 100% checklist and every collectible and activity. There is no shortcut: work through the roadmap stages in order and it will pop once the final trophy lands.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Jason and Lucia at the start of the story. Just play through the mission as directed; it cannot be missed and unlocks early in Chapter 1. This is the first story trophy and a good check that your tracking is working.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. Play through the chapter's missions in order; the chapter trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter's final mission ends. Nothing here is missable, and free-roam continues after the story anyway.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Keep playing the main missions in order and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Like every chapter trophy, it is automatic and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. The story runs across five chapters, so this is the midpoint chapter trophy. Play the main missions in order and it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. You are one chapter from the finale at this point, so keep pushing the main missions. The trophy unlocks automatically when the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story, which closes Chapter 5. Finish the story's last mission and the trophy unlocks with the credits. After the credits, free-roam continues, so any unfinished trophies can still be earned.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story missions unlock in order as you play; finish this one and the trophy pops. It is part of the main story path, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story milestones, so play through it as directed and the trophy unlocks on completion. Prepare for a big set-piece: stock up on ammo and armour before you start.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. This is a named story mission, so it unlocks automatically when you finish it. There is nothing extra to do: just play the mission through.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Named story missions like this one unlock their trophy the moment the mission ends. Play it in story order and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission as directed and the trophy pops on completion. It is a story mission, so there is no way to miss it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. This is a named story mission, so the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. Play through it in story order; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion, tracked under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist itself only appears there after the credits roll. PowerPyx reports the checklist has about 35 requirements and counts as roughly 60% of true completion, needing 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. Expect this to be the longest grind of the platinum, around 100 hours after the story, and plan on it being the last trophy before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the game's jump and stunt challenges; PowerPyx notes 300 of 397 stunts count toward 100% completion, so the trophy's 250 is a step on that road. Work through them steadily during free-roam and check progress in the Stats menu.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks which activity types you have sampled — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade games and the rest — so dip into every activity at least once. This is a sampler trophy, not a mastery one: one try of each type is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the shooting ranges and work through each challenge until you hit the gold-medal score; PowerPyx lists 42 challenges in total. Gold medals take practice, so treat this as a skill trophy and revisit ranges between story missions.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone-race location, enter the race and finish first. There is one race per location, so sweep them all; check the map for unvisited race markers.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races across Leonida count — road, off-road and other formats — but each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins. PowerPyx notes 30 unique wins are needed for 100% completion, so keep racing past this trophy's 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take on Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him; fishing is one of the game's side activities, so head to a fishing spot and accept the challenge when it appears. A decent rod setup and patience with the reeling mechanic help.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start a game and play it through to completion. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, one of the Strangers & Freaks contacts. Work through Andy's mission strand in order; the trophy unlocks when his last mission ends. Stranger strands are optional side content, available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, one of the Strangers & Freaks contacts. Work through Kenton's mission strand in order; the trophy unlocks when his last mission ends. Stranger strands stay available in post-story free-roam.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, one of the Strangers & Freaks contacts. Work through Billy's mission strand in order; the trophy unlocks when his last mission ends. Stranger strands stay available in post-story free-roam.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. There are more than 8 stranger strands in the game, so pick the eight you enjoy most and finish each one. Strands unlock as you explore, so keep an eye on the map for new stranger markers.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, one of the Strangers & Freaks contacts. Work through Randy's mission strand in order; the trophy unlocks when his last mission ends. Stranger strands stay available in post-story free-roam.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, one of the Strangers & Freaks contacts. Work through Tyrone's mission strand in order; the trophy unlocks when his last mission ends. Stranger strands stay available in post-story free-roam.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. This is the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as possibly missable: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, on the morning after the mission Down to Earth — talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is unconfirmed whether that first meditation is actually required for the trophy, so do it to be safe, then meditate at every other spot you find. If you missed the Chapter 1 moment, keep playing: whether it blocks the trophy is still unconfirmed as of launch week, 19 Nov 2026.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves hunting a specific animal; follow his missions until the unique-animal hunt appears, then track and take it down. Use binoculars to study animals first — studying 100 of 255 animals also feeds 100% completion.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. PowerPyx notes 15 of 18 sets are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy's 3 sets are only the start — keep collecting.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the game's photo-sharing app: take and share photos at 100 different locations across Leonida. Spread it out as you explore so the count grows naturally, and check progress in Stats.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's assorted feats, tracked in the Stats menu; PowerPyx reports 70 of 80 challenges are needed for 100% completion, so 50 is a milestone on the way. Mix combat, driving, exploration and activity challenges to build the count.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, build your wanted level to 4 stars, then break line of sight and escape until the stars clear. Wide open roads and a fast car help; avoid roadblocks while the search is on.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hold up three shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level the whole time — do not let it drop between robberies. Plan a route with three close shops and a getaway car ready.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles are discovered by driving or scanning them; PowerPyx reports 200 of 277 vehicles scanned count toward 100% completion, so keep scanning everything you meet. Variety helps — new models count, repeats do not.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus during a firefight and drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with plenty of cover and clustered enemies, and aim for headshots to make each shot count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, find a way to leave on a plane that is not on the schedule — the description is deliberately vague, and as of launch week no guide has confirmed the exact steps. Try the airport's airside areas and look for a plane you can board or steal; check the cited guides for player reports as they appear.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The official description is a one-liner — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and the exact method is unconfirmed as of launch week, 19 Nov 2026. The name points at the Rhino tank, so expect it to involve driving or fighting in one; do not trust any specific steps until a cited guide confirms them. Check the PowerPyx guide and the trophy lists linked below for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, enter quietly and take the goods without tripping alarms or being spotted by staff or cameras. A stealthy approach and a quick exit are the whole trick — if you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are bigger jobs than shop robberies; complete five and get clear of the police each time. Plan each one, bring your partner if the job allows, and have a fast getaway ready.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take its cash and escape the wanted level that follows. Trucks spawn on set routes — watch the roads and strike when one is isolated.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the map — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the countryside — until the map is fully revealed. This pairs naturally with the WAiNK, vehicle and card hunts, so explore thoroughly rather than fast-travelling everywhere.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Each gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang. Learn which gangs hold which territory, then work through the list one gang at a time.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or venue on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail and enjoy it — the exact venue is unconfirmed as of launch week, 19 Nov 2026, so treat this as a best-effort pointer. Check the cited guides for player-confirmed locations as they appear.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description points at a showroom smash-and-grab in the style of the series' classic moments; the exact showroom and trigger are unconfirmed as of launch week. Try the vehicle showrooms in Vice City and check the cited guides for confirmations.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit the bowling alley run by Kolt & Associates and play a game through — the follow-through line suggests finishing a full game. The exact trigger is unconfirmed as of launch week; check the cited guides for player reports.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — gives no location or steps, and the method is unconfirmed as of launch week, 19 Nov 2026. It sounds like a partner-activity trophy; play the partner activities and check the cited guides as players pin it down.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — the method is unconfirmed as of launch week. This reads like a story-choice trophy; play the story and watch for a decision point, and check the cited guides for confirmations rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' — the method is unconfirmed as of launch week, 19 Nov 2026. The wording suggests retrying something after a first failure; check the cited guides for player reports before spending time on guesses.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' — the method is unconfirmed as of launch week. The description suggests an odd or secret encounter; explore Leonida's stranger corners and check the cited guides as players report it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. At the bowling alley, knock pins over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon, as the name says. Line up a slow pass past the pins and swing as you go by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; pass them to your laundering contacts, who take a cut, and bank $250,000 of clean money in total. Keep laundering after every big score and the total climbs steadily.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Money spent in shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything — counts toward the $100,000 total. Spend normally as you play and it will come; big purchases like vehicles help if you are short.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available across Leonida. Garages cost money, so fund this with laundered earnings and check the property listings on the in-game internet as new ones unlock.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register ten vehicles you own or find. Open the app, follow the registration prompt for each vehicle, and repeat until you hit ten.
trophies.name: On the Spot
